notes.title: The Visceral Update!
notes.content:
[h2]🎯THE VISCERAL UPDATE!🎯[/h2]
Thanks to our incredible community, we're rolling out a BIG update that brings even more excitement to NO RELOADING: Survival Trials! Let’s dive into the highlights!

[h2]💥SPECTACULAR VISUAL UPGRADES!💥[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/22644c085b82717f9ec9df1ce06b5b6111612ec3.png[/img]
Your destruction has never looked so beautiful. We've amped up the visuals to make every hit feel incredible:
[list][*]New "gore" effects: enemies burst into satisfying crystalline bits leaving glittery debris everywhere!
[*]Epic muzzle flashes like your favorite action movies!
[*]Camera now subtly reacts to gunfire and strafing.  This tiny change dramatically increases the cinematic feel of combat!
[*]Yellow hit marker now appears on crosshair for clearer feedback!
[*]Roger's tractor beam limbs now "pop" more thanks to clever outlining; otherwise sometimes it looked like Roger was losing his legs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/413e1533cc504f7cb6b49b9f4dd5b56c66d0703a.png[/img][/list]

[h2]🎁NEW FREE AUGMENTS!🎁[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/a1a097a1d26e1116ff71a93a7b640bef87600440.png[/img]
We've made some of your favorite abilities and augments into FREE augments, meaning more choices per run without burning a level-up! This adds even more customization to your playstyle.
[list][*]All improvements to existing augments are now free!
[*]Super Jump: Soar to new heights!
[*]Steal: Yank weapons right out of enemy's hands!
[*]Fast Fall: Land faster and STOMP!
[*]Disarm: Shoot enemy's weapons right out of their hands, coming straight to you!
[*]Chrono-Gaze: Slow down time like a true gunslinger!
[*]Gundar: Master the art of scavenging!
[*]Compass: Never get lost again!
[*]Grab Range: Pick up things across the room!
[*]Kick Range: Kick enemies across the room too!
[*]Reset Kick Cooldown: Unleash non-stop melee attacks!
[*]And more![/list]

[h2]🌟QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES🌟[/h2]
We’ve packed in a ton of improvements to make gameplay smoother than ever!
[list][*]Color-coded pick-up notifications now appear in the top-left like classic FPS games, showing weapons, ammo, XP, etc.

[*]Starting pistols and chests now also available in the Hub room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/f0528600747cd7776475f95962f6d32c1e3492bd.png[/img]
[*]Roger no longer freezes when depleting a slide; keep that momentum going!
[*]De-janked brutal mode's confusing hub teleporter.
[/list]

[h2]🐛BUG FIXES🐛[/h2]
A smoother experience awaits with these critical bug fixes:
[list][*]Fixed funky legs on Roger in the main menu.
[*]Collectibles Found stat now correctly counts.
[*]Many more I neglected to take note of, haha![/list]

[h2]☕JUST GETTING STARTED!☕[/h2]
We’re just scratching the surface! There’s so much more coming, so be sure to share your epic moments and feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Discord community[/url]. Keep slaying, survivors! If you’re particularly awesome, I might even add a collectible in your honor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/eef3341951c23e1dbbc27a1d10cccfd6d1e12db5.png[/img]

notes.title: The Theme Update!
notes.content:
[h2]🔥NEW UPDATES🔥[/h2]
Thanks to our playtesters on Discord, I have been busily improving NO RELOADING: Survival Trials!

[h2]🖼️THEME SELECTION!🖼️[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/231dd625d78b1138d52507b32d5e04ac637a988f.png[/img]
After playing a short while, new players will now be prompted to choose their preferred visual theme!  
[list][*] STANDARD: 90s Nostalgia!  Slightly pixelated and has "Roger vision" edge detection.
[*] SLICK: Clean and modern for that classic pretty low poly look.
[/list]
Players may choose overall theme, or fiddle with specific aspects, in Options at any time.

It will be fun to see which theme players prefer!  Tell me your preference in our [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Discord community[/url]!

[*]Heal on Scavenge: Scavenging ammunition heals!

[list][*]Added dithering slider in graphical options.

[h2]🐛BUG FIXES🐛[/h2]
[list][*]Enemies traveling under floor in Pool Room.[/list]

notes.title: Streamer Mode Insanity Updates and Much More!
notes.content:
I've been hard at work adding thrilling updates of NO RELOADING: Survival Trials. Experience enhanced gameplay, thrilling new features, and crucial fixes for an unbeatable stylish rogue-lite experience!

[h2]🎮Streamer Mode Enhancements🎮[/h2]
[list][*][b]New Viewer Commands[/b]: Enrich your streaming experience with a range of new viewer commands like spawning skeletons and applying buffs to enemies!  Answer the streamer mode trivia questions in game to learn all the commands!
[*][b]Viewer Votes[/b]: Viewers can now vote to spawn hordes, drop rare weapons chests, disarm Roger, reload Roger's guns, despawn all nearby weapons, and much more.[/list]

[h2]🔥New Features🔥[/h2]
[list][*][b]Crosshair Status Indicator[/b]: Stay informed with a new crosshair showing the state of reverse projectiles, gunslinger, gun-kata, shoot dodge, cartwheel, and more.
[*][b]Shortcut Teleporters[/b]: Access later episodes faster with new shortcut teleporters, making your journey through the trials more dynamic.  Kill bosses to gain the teleporter keys!
[*][b]Enhanced Run Stats[/b]: Track your progress with best, last, and average stats tracking.[/list]

[h2]👾Polish and User Interface Improvements👾[/h2]
[list][*][b]World-space Controls Update[/b]: Improved the display of left and right controls text for better clarity.
[*][b]Limited Computer Interaction Angles[/b]: Was mighty confusing to try to use the in-game computer at extreme angles![/list]

[h2]🎯Balance and Gameplay Adjustments🎯[/h2]
[list][*][b]New Player Balance[/b]: Adjusted difficulty for new players, offering a smoother learning curve.
[*][b]Mushba Anticipation[/b]: Increased anticipation time for Mushba's attacks for better player response.
[*][b]Player Speed Rarity[/b]: Increased the likelihood of speed augment drops, enhancing mobility and agility.[/list]

[h2]🛠Bug Fixes🛠[/h2]
[list][*][b]Throwing Mechanics[/b]: Adjusted maximum throw power to prevent throwing through walls.
[*][b]Keybind Text Updates[/b]: Fixed an issue where keybind texts weren't updating upon changes.
[*][b]Skeleton Animations[/b]: Resolved floating skeletons issue to ensure natural enemy movements.
[*][b]Camera Polish[/b]: Finally fixed the forever-old looking up/down spin problem![/list]

[h2]We're Just Getting Started![/h2]
Stay tuned for more updates, tweaks, and thrilling additions. Your journey through Survival Trials is evolving - are you ready for the next level of action?

Remember to share your feedback, suggestions, and epic moments in our [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Discord community[/url]. Happy gaming!

notes.title: The Difficulty Shake-Up Update
notes.content:
We're shaking things up! Brace yourself for more balance, more control, more variety, and yes, new difficulty levels! Here's a speedy rundown of what's fresh:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Choose Your Battle: Normal, Hard, and Brutal difficulties added - get ready to choose your own adventure!
[*]Brutal Mode Mix-up: Campaign order shuffled in Brutal mode for the ultimate variety spice![/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list][*]Cooler Guns, Cooler Rules: Miniguns are rarer, but tougher, and with a ramping fire rate for that added drama!
[*]Enemy Spawns: Now a bit less hectic in Highway, with brighter street lamps for better avoidance.
Reinforcements Pull Back: Enemies less likely to spawn while you grab those upgrade orbs.
[*]Augment Chances: Auto-scavenger augment boosted - finding this gem is now easier![/list]
[h1]Polish[/h1]
[list][*]Roger Chats More: Now our favorite bot gets chatty when his weapon breaks.
[*]Upgrade Choices UI: Sleek new look for easier navigation![/list]
[h1]Bugs Squashed[/h1]
[list][*]No Self-Inflicted Damage: Your sword can't hit your shield anymore, phew!
[*]Fixed Projectile Overload: The minigun only shoots one projectile per shot now, as it should![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/eef3341951c23e1dbbc27a1d10cccfd6d1e12db5.png[/img]
We're continually working on improving your survival trials! Keep those guns blazing, champions!

(This news was published about a week late!  What can we say?  Work'n hard!)

notes.title: 🏹 THE HEAVY UPDATE: Crossbows, Mouse Hordes (!?) & More! 🐁
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/8cddf3f5a9c13ea70496cd5ea38e709afb1cb4d5.png[/img]🔥 Time to gear up! NO RELOADING: Survival Trials is back with an explosive update that will blow your circuits! Your training montage is now juicier, meaner, and packed with even more adrenaline-pumping action. Grab your weapons and dive into the frenzy! 🎮

[h1]🎖 The Ultimate Survival Trials 🎖[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/d9c6aa3b242be9e5f34a03fd7495610d67b82b77.png[/img]We've overhauled the Survival Trials for a more challenging and gratifying experience. Say hello to distinct chapters, each ten levels deep, ending in intense boss fights. Journey your way through themed chapters like the Proving Grounds, Ancient Times, and Modern Times. Face off against ferocious enemies as you delve deeper into each chapter. Oh, and did we mention, there’s a heap of new rooms like the epic Castle, and the majestic Greek Temple? 😎

[h1]👾 Enemies on Steroids! 👾[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/2c7339b755c4cdc4906e047f67bd76884c9e56ac.png[/img]Get ready to face the hordes! Enemies are now smarter, diversified, and more relentless. Heavies join the fray with extra hit points and resistance, dropping double the loot. Watch out for rampaging minions, including the fearsome mouse bot, with heightened senses, and, rumor has it, they have learned how to search for you! 😱
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/96f3f5d62a1570bb88751d7619efc41168d4dbdb.png[/img]

[h1]🌟 Polished to Mirror Sheen! 🌟[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/2d170afd8da89c6167ece18f620969f4d14e6392.png[/img]Experience the glory of the new and improved environmental reflections – they’re so darn pretty! And of course, we've done away with various pesky music and visual bugs for a seamless battle symphony. 🎶

[h1]🌈 Pick-ups & Upgrades Bonanza! 🌈[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/0afd5a55d0070a92470b5ad567dd9058efa317df.png[/img]Up your game with dazzling pick-ups and upgrades. Introducing Rare Weapon Chests and snazzy ammunition pick-ups, so you’ll always be prepared for the next fight! If you’re lucky, you may even find the infamous MINIGUN! The upgrade window is smarter and shows how many pending upgrades await, and level-ups queue up and won’t interrupt your killer combos. It’s raining upgrades and they’re all yours! 💰

[h1]🏹 Enter the Crossbow! 🏹[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/47d877de8418b2d1d51bd58423cc3679a3942efe.png[/img]Unleash the fury of the brand new crossbow! Precise, deadly, and just plain awesome - this new weapon is set to redefine your combat tactics. Get your hands on it and let the bolts fly! 🎯

[h1]🌟 Shoutouts & Thanks! 🌟[/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/19c50d350abca7542bfe58d69df9042fe8c0aa26.png[/img][/url]Our heartfelt thanks to the community, especially @lackofwords, @Zorder, @Fqed, @LumpyLatino, and @AngryWorm for your invaluable feedback. We couldn’t have done this without you! 📢

[h1]🚀What are you waiting for?💣[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159683/eef3341951c23e1dbbc27a1d10cccfd6d1e12db5.png[/img]  Jump into NO RELOADING: Survival Trials and experience the onslaught like never before! This is the ultimate showdown, and only the toughest will survive. Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769060/NO_RELOADING_Survival_Trials/]wishlist[/url] the game on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]share your training montages[/url] with us! 🔫

notes.title: THE ONE Update for Demo
notes.content:
We have had an epic many weeks with the help of the G.Round crew, streamers, and players beating the bejeebers out of the evil goblins!

Trying something new this time!  Here are the highlights of this update in VIDEO form!
[previewyoutube=JwagB6ztmaQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Haven't tried the demo yet?  This trailer will give you a taste of what you're missing!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769060/NO_RELOADING/][previewyoutube=STHx8dHCCCI;full][/previewyoutube]Join the fun in the free demo/prologue on Steam today![/url]

Just in case the video isn't good enough, here are the full patch notes:

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list][*]Tutorials now primarily appear in the new shooting ranges.
[*]Added acid containment room, requiring super jumping.
[*]Added lobby with laser defenses, requiring sliding.
[*]Kicking now acts like a throw.  Kicked enemies can be aimed with the crosshair, and will deal damage when colliding another enemy.
[*]Added Focus Upgrade, increasing accuracy when using manual bullet time.
[*]Higher difficulties are now unlocked in meta-progression.
[*]Stunt abilities now are more likely to show up early game.
[*]Added posters to the goblin compound, including references to many of the streamers who have supported and enjoyed NO RELOADING!
[*]Roger now speaks about ambushes.
[*]Roger now speaks about moving to the next floor if the player stays too long on one floor.
[*]Roger now mentions he must have a free hand to use Reverse Projectiles.
[*]Roger will now speak about using shoot dodge and slide to increase accuracy when dazed.
[*]Players may now disable tutorials in options.
[*]Players can now choose which shoulder the camera will follow in options.
[*]Added more phrases to the giant tips before each level.
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Increased healing on kill's chain bonus.
[*]Wrecking Ball now heals five hit points per item destroyed, opposed to one.
[*]Decreased points necessary for meta-progression upgrades.
[*]Rerolling upgrades now is less likely to show the same upgrades.
[*]Increased pistol and stun gun ammunition counts.
[*]Upgrades that increase healing on kill are now labeled in green.
[*]Battle music more likely to trigger.
[*]Foundry is more common, but only shows up after level five.
[*]Super Jump now says to hold the jump key.
[*]Goblin scientists will no longer respawn.
[*]CRT effect in options now states that it only impacts the user interface.
[*]Keybinds belonging to upgrades are now labeled in options.
[*]Increased size of "Hold [ESCAPE] to skip" text, and made it larger.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Looking down in normal play no longer makes Roger spin.
[*]Can only start gunslinger if there is a target.
[*]Goblins should not be able to get stuck under the stairs in the Command Center anymore.
[*]Resilience upgrades are no longer kept after death.
[*]Lava (and acid) will no longer spawn particle effects forever at the origin.
[/list]

notes.title: META Update for Demo
notes.content:
We have had an epic two weeks with the help of the G.Round crew, streamers, and players beating the bejeebers out of the evil goblins!

Haven't tried the demo yet?  This trailer will give you a taste of what you're missing!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769060/NO_RELOADING/][previewyoutube=STHx8dHCCCI;full][/previewyoutube]Join the fun in the free demo/prologue on Steam today![/url]

[h1]Meta-Progression[/h1]
Meta-progression in NO RELOADING focuses on aesthetics and convenience upgrades, not direct power upgrades.
[list][*]Points earned each run can be used to purchase meta-progression upgrades, that stick with you on all future runs.  Further reason to be stylish!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3m8koTv.png[/img]
[*]Until the upgrades are unlocked in meta-progression, they can also appear as normal upgrades.
[*]Health Sensor: Adds a health bar over any enemies you look at.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lXGMDwT.png[/img]
[*]First Person Mode: Allows you to enable first-person in options.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/clGRdvN.png[/img]
[*]3 Choices per Upgrade: You will be given three upgrade choices instead of two.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U0VKf8u.png[/img]
[*]4 Choices per Upgrade: You will be given four upgrade choices instead of two.
[*]3 Rerolls per Run: Are can reroll your upgrades three times per run.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U0VKf8u.png[/img]
[*]6 Rerolls per Run: You can reroll your upgrades six times per run.
[*]Longer Reach: Can be bought as a meta-progression upgrade.
[*]Read Ammunition: See exact ammunition counts of weapons you are holding and on the ground!
[*]Lanyard: Hold key without occupying a hand.  Also automates key pick-up.
[*]Compass: Innate knowledge where the exit is.
[*]Roger-Time Not Required: The first upgrade no longer must be Roger-Time.
[*]Second Arm: Grants your second arm immediately.
[*]Steady: Increased accuracy recovery when crouching.
[/list]
[h1]Upgrades[/h1]
[list][*]Scavenger: Pressing your reload key automatically picks up nearby ammunition and adds it to the weapon you're wielding.  This upgrade now requires you to have your second arm beforehand.
[*]Auto-Scavenger: Roger will automatically reload his weapons when nearby ammunition sources.  No free hands necessary!
[*]Lucky Magazines: Each weapon Roger picks up has full ammunition.
[*]Extended Magazines: Each weapon Roger picks up can hold 50% more ammunition.
[*]Wrecking Ball: Each prop destroyed in the environment heals Roger for 1 HP.
[*]Glorious Kick: Kicks insta-kills near-death enemies and heal Roger for 25 HP.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U1cNmsL.png[/img]
[*]Tactical Shooter: Increases accuracy recovery when crouching.  Heal after 10 seconds of no damage.
[*]Slide: Automatically slows down time when looking at an enemy while wielding a ranged weapon.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/foQ4Q31.png[/img]
[*]Extended Slide: Doubles the duration of slide.
[*]Infinite Slide
[*]Roger-Time: Now limited to five seconds of manual bullet-time.  Sorry LoiseLives :-P.  BUT, it can be upgraded in different ways!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SWqCISU.png[/img]
[*]Extended Roger-Time: Ten seconds of manual bullet-time.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tvv2LdG.png[/img]
[*]Vengeful Roger-Time: Earn manual bullet-time on kill.
[*]Gunslinger: No longer has a charge up time.  Instead, it has a cooldown.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9upGlm1.png[/img]
[*]Super Throw: Now knocks out opponents.
[*]Additional Dash Charge
[*]Decreased Shoot Dodge Cooldown
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3UwJkYZ.png[/img]
[*]Speed: Increases Roger's speed.
[*]Ridiculous Speed: Increases Roger's speed again.
[*]Ludicrous Speed: Increases Roger's speed yet again!
[*]Resilience: Increases Roger's health at the cost of speed.
[*]More Resilience: Increases Roger's health at the cost of speed.
[/list]
[h1]Tutorialization[/h1]
[list]Player is now taught to combine shoot dodge and sliding to earn more healing on kills.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pl1K5fc.png[/img]
[*]Player is now taught to shoot dodge or slide while dazed to regain accuracy.
[*]Player is now taught to get kills with shoot dodge.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GwLRNJq.png[/img]
[*]Giant tips at the start of each level, informing player to use particular stunts more, how to heal, and more.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kBTbLN4.png[/img]
[*]All upgrades now state whether they can increase your healing on kill when used.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Wt8oXor.png[/img]
[*]Heal on Kill combo user interface show will display a dialog reminding players to combine stunts when low on health.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZnknJNB.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Polish[/h1]
[list][*]A big red animated X now appears when killing targets.  No more confusion whether they're dead!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EL7LJxy.png[/img]
[*]Heal on kills numbers at top left now animate when increasing.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gvWkcEt.png[/img]
[*]User interface text for wielded weapons now animates when picking up new items.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wUMJYIt.png[/img]
[*]Roger now speaks about items being shot out of his hands.
[*]Roger now speaks about bumping into enemies.
[*]Goblins now react more intelligently: space out more, avoid friendly fire, run away when close to Roger.
[*]Ammunition for weapons Roger is wielding is displayed as a percentage, until they get the Read Ammunition upgrade.
[*]Knocked out targets now show sleepy Zs over their head, instead of the spinning stars.  Spinning stars still appear when dazed.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RV9OAup.png[/img]
[*]Now provide better upgrade recommendations.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U0VKf8u.png[/img]
[*]Upgrades user interface how includes more information per upgrade, such as cool-down times and more.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PWj3NpG.png[/img]
[*]Shoot dodge, slide, and reroll counts now appear in statistics panel when applicable.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8fJtb1L.png[/img]
[*]Disabled over-shoulder zoom when shooting.
[*]Keybindings now show duplicate keys in red text.
[*]Controls user interface now says, "Throw EMPTY X," to ensure player knows they can throw an empty weapon, opposed to a loaded weapon.
[*]Added several additional "pro tips" on level completion window.
[*]Added run points beside level points on level completion window.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pXO7wCj.png[/img]
[*]Increased size of contextual control prompts.
[*]Distinct New Game versus Continue Game buttons in main menu.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MrFPnrS.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed poison stew objective not triggering in Mess Halls.
Fixed bug preventing some goblins from shooting consistently.  End result is that all goblins shoot more often now, and are less likely to deal friendly fire!
[*]Tactical dual wield and gunslinger can now target through doorways.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/K042jdh.png[/img]
[*]Tactical dual wield and gunslinger can now target through broken glass.
[*]Tactical dual wield and gunslinger now function even when shoot dodging, sliding, or performing other movement stunts.
[*]Tactical dual wield will no longer "control" Roger's guns after tactical dual wield has finished.
[*]Can no longer shoot your own guns or your own projectiles.
[*]CRT filter option was not applied to all scenes.
[*]Less likely to dodge through walls.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JIevjB2.png[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: G.Round Updates for Demo
notes.content:
We have had an epic few days with the help of the G.Round crew, streamers, and players beating the bejeebers out of the evil goblins!

Haven't tried the demo yet?  This trailer will give you a taste of what you're missing!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769060/NO_RELOADING/][previewyoutube=STHx8dHCCCI;full][/previewyoutube]Join the fun in the free demo/prologue on Steam today![/url]

[h1]Clarity[/h1]
[list][*]You can now kick, even if there are no targets nearby.  No more, "why does the kick button not work?!" even though it actually was technically working...
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gmywlzm.png[/img]
[*]Progress toward finding Roger's dog, Duke, is now displayed at the end of each level.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rlM4yFX.png[/img]
[*]Tactical dual wield now requires having a second arm first.  Kinda hard to dual wield without two arms!
[*]Scavenger now requires having a second arm first.  Again, kinda hard to scavenge ammunition if you can't hold a gun and ammunition at the same time!
[*]Score pop-ups now say "HP" if the kill helped heal you. For example, "+10 HP" if the kill healed you 10 hit points.  Otherwise, if you're already at full health, it will simply say, "+10."  Also, increased the size of all score pop-ups.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eF0ZAtl.png[/img]
[*]A Roger-wielded bonk stick now deals more damage, ensuring new players don't think that the bonk stick isn't working.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UKIzuQy.png[/img]
[*]The first few levels, Roger cannot be stunned by stun guns.  New players were overwhelmed and confused by all the goblins armed with stun guns, making Roger annoyingly drop his weapons all the time!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kSHUwmb.png[/img]
[*]The red kill marker on the crosshair is now substantially bigger!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tV06TH6.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Polish[/h1]
[list][*]You can now reduce, or shut off, the CRT filter user interface effect in options.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6xOuzqc.png[/img]
[*]Substantially increased legibility of all text.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SVE0KEB.png[/img]
[*]Key cards can now be spotted as long as you are in the same room as the key card, even if they are obstructed by debris.  This should reduce the likelihood of you having no hint via the objective arrow as to where to find the key.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WZ40cvj.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed issue where on-screen prompts did not show the correct keybindings.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PfL00Fg.png[/img]
[*]Fixed bug where the "get dog food" objective was not being properly cleared in the city prologue.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Oh0NCGc.png[/img]
[*]Glass shattering was not using the right sound volume mixer, and thus was louder than other sounds.
[*]Fixed bug where it said the permanent lanyard was unlocked, when in actuality it was first person view that was unlocked.
[*]Fixed initialization bug that occurred when running the game with the Turkish language.
[/list]

notes.title: OBJECTIVES Update for Demo
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for sharing their feedback and letting us watch you stream!  This update's additions and improvements were all directly inspired by you!

Check out the slick updated demo trailer!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769060/NO_RELOADING/][previewyoutube=STHx8dHCCCI;full][/previewyoutube]Try all these new features below in the free demo/prologue on Steam today![/url]

[h1]New Side Objectives[/h1]
Completing side objectives heals Roger 100 hit points.
[list][*]Storage room: destroy ammunition dump to increase enemy reload time.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U4bLqbz.png[/img]
[*]Offices: destroy intelligence.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oN0pX2U.png[/img]
[*]Command Center: assassinate commander.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B2twu5W.png[/img]
[*]Mess hall: poison stew slowly damage goblin reinforcements.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jyA0t9p.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Events[/h1]
[list][*]When goblins invade rooms, the lights will be dramatically shut off.  CHUNK CHUNK CHUNK!
[*]New room invasion theme: bots.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V7dIB1O.png[/img]
[*]New room invasion theme: suicide bots.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UyfJTk7.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]New Rooms[/h1]
[list][*]Giant zoo, and the remnants of the strange creatures the goblins were studying.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/r4RK68L.png[/img]
[*]Checkpoints!  The goblins are none to happy with you attacking their compound!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gVChmLl.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]New Enemies[/h1]
[list][*]Stun Bot: Suicide bot that zaps and stuns nearby enemies.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZpCWOwi.png[/img]
[*]Bomb Bot: Suicide bot that explodes when close to target.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KcKeo3f.png[/img]
[*]Laser Mini-Tank: A miniature tank that fires at Roger, or beneath Roger, creating an area of denial.  Stay airborne to avoid being hit!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fBgoeN8.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]New Exits[/h1]
No longer is a key card required to exit every single floor.  There are now three different types of exits.
[list][*]Plain ol' elevator.  No prerequisites required!
[*]Key card elevator, just like the prior versions of the demo.
[*]DNA scan elevator, requiring Roger to grab and scan a live goblin to unlock!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5l4udM2.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Ability Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Kick now has a short cooldown.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vVoujDK.png[/img]
[*]Shoot dodge now has a short cooldown.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CJ6ZKYb.png[/img]
[*]Shoot dodge can be cancelled by either crouching or jumping.
[*]High kick now launches enemies upward like a rocket!
[/list]
[h1]New Meta Progression[/h1]
There is now the beginnings of meta progression!  The goal here is to focus on convenience and aesthetic upgrades permanently.  Utilitarian upgrades will remain as they are now, found during each run.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/O2hhDT0.png[/img]
[list][*]First person mode!  Complete any run, win or lose, and you can play in first person!  Choose first or third person in options once unlocked.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/clGRdvN.png[/img]
[*]Permanent lanyard!  Win or lose any run, after attaining the lanyard, and keep it forever!  Remember, the lanyard not only frees up a hand, but also automates Roger picking up the key for you.
[/list]
[h1]Polish[/h1]
[list][*]Added visual trail effect when Roger is shoot dodging.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GCRysDy.png[/img]
[*]Legs and arms now leave behind a residual glow and sparkles when turned on or off.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/20lGhlb.png[/img]
[*]Added instant restart button at the end of each run, skipping the introduction scenes.
[*]Roger will no longer pick up the key card after death.
[*]Roger should no longer speak after death, besides his quip.
[*]Goblin body and limbs should no longer disappeared when sent into a ragdoll state.
[*]Goblin reinforcements will no longer appear so close to Roger.
[*]Camera will now slide to the left side of Roger is he is only equipping an item in his left hand, to allow the player to easily see what Roger is wielding.
[*]Mech is now delayed to the very end of the demo.
[*]Tweaked mech's damage output and health.
[*]Polished destructibility of many electronic objects, such as laptops and computer screens.
[/list]

notes.title: COMBO Update for Demo
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769060/NO_RELOADING/][previewyoutube=oMlYEz5zXic;full][/previewyoutube]Try all these new features below in the free demo/prologue on Steam today![/url]

[h1]New Combo User Interface[/h1]
[list][*]Clearly denotes that kills give health.  No more waiting until the end of a level to heal!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CfmDZRq.png[/img]
[*]Clearly states that chaining abilities together gets you the most health.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1kxI6kh.png[/img]
[*]Shows which abilities offer more health.  Specifically, melee-centric abilities.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3rDqj4G.png[/img]
[*]Easy to see how much time remains per ability.

[h1]New Greenhouse Room[/h1]
The Goblins have a GIGANTIC greenhouse in their compound... but for what evil purpose?!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oLcDF2b.png[/img]

[h1]Lanyard Improvements[/h1]
Once equipped with a lanyard, Roger will automatically pick up key cards in range, even if both hands are occupied.  However, having a free hand maximizes the auto-grab range.  No more fumbling with dropping items to pick up a card!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vMiuVb4.png[/img]

[h1]Improved Crosshair[/h1]
Taking inspiration from good ol' Counter-Strike, the crosshair now grows bigger as your guns lose accuracy.  For example, the crosshair will bloom when spraying automatic weapons, when weapons are hit by projectiles or other debris, or rapidly spinning around.  This makes it clearer that certain abilities, specifically sliding and shoot dodging, greatly increases how fast Roger will reorient his guns.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ODFg01Z.png[/img]
Poor accuracy.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/I3nIXEn.png[/img]
Good accuracy, thanks to shoot dodge.

[h1]Objective Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]Top right objective text will now explicitly state to explore to find the exit.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jglPjgl.png[/img]
[*]You may now destroy any server to complete the destroy server objective.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/e2me8Zb.png[/img]
[*]Servers are no longer strangely super explosive... now they spark upon destruction.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Iin49Pf.png[/img]
[*]Objectives now give health immediately upon completion.  For example, destroying the server.
[/list]
[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list][*]Added ability bar to bottom of screen, with controls.  Gives you a sense of what you have attained in the run.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VFUw2uC.png[/img]
[*]Death screen is now delayed a few seconds, so players can enjoy how they failed terribly.  Roger also speaks a witty line.
[*]Game now mentions that you can cancel shoot dodging with dash.  (We will be adding canceling to shoot dodging soon.)
[*]Added mouse sensitivity to Options.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0NAChVX.png[/img]
[*]One of our biggest requests, surprisingly: On/off options no longer use sliders, but instead traditional toggle buttons.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wVJ1KKa.png[/img]
[*]Options now mentions that CTRL+G toggles the GUI.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xYnCFF5.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Polish[/h1]
[list][*]Thrown saw blades now stick to walls. :-D
[*]Lockable doors now have an obvious screen stating whether they are locked or not, and what is necessary to unlock them.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sHKZfZz.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8Y6Lb4x.png[/img]
[*]Key card spawns are now less predictable.
[*]Projectiles now pierce through glass shards.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ER1aeSL.png[/img]
[*]Roger will now speak about being stylish to regain health, when low at health.
[*]There is now a tutorial on how to drop items.
[*]Roger will now recommend switching guns when a gun runs out of ammunition.
[*]Robots now drop debris upon death.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Roger now will say "out of ammo" upon the last bullet being fired, instead of one click later.
[*]Lava now destroys interactables, like key cards.  (Don't worry, key cards will respawn!)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/piwGoCJ.png[/img]

[*]Level completion screen will now show, despite not earning any points.
[*]Escape KEY no longer impacts pause menu when other windows are open on top.
[/list]

notes.title: RETRO Update for Demo
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for their continued feedback regarding the demo of NO RELOADING!  It has been very helpful in making NO RELOADING a better experience!

[h1]New "RETRO" User Interface Style![/h1]
We have revamped the UI to embrace the blocky, 80s-style, CRT console user interfaces of the past, and it looks darn neat!  Also very satisfying to interact with!
[previewyoutube=_EYrPa4AHCM;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, new main menu and logo!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uTspZge.png[/img]

[h1]Bullet-Time Enhancements![/h1]
[list][*]Added dedicated bullet-time button!  Hold [SHIFT]!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hJP4l5G.png[/img]
[*]Added option to disable automatic bullet-time.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MlAtx9u.png[/img]
[*]Bullet-time will no longer automatically trigger from your own projectiles.
[*]You may now use shoot dodge, even when you do not have a gun.
[*]Updated bullet-time description to be more clear.
[/list]
[h1]Ability Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Roger now starts each run, even in the demo, with bare minimum abilities, kick and jump.  We discovered that players were either unaware, or overwhelmed, by the "freebie" abilities.  Also, players did not get the enjoyment of choosing their own starting abilities.  Now Roger "remembers" a new ability each floor.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/abgDZVC.png[/img]
[*]Recommended upgrades are now highlighted, to aid players in choosing the most impactful upgrades early on.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RHyRgdj.png[/img]
[*]Explosive barrels now explode when thrown!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oNhBINn.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list][*]Added lobby room, inspired by the Matrix!  Complete with destructible pillars!
[*]Added gallery, with destructible statues!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J5jwd1L.png[/img]
[*]Doors now have room labels!  No more, "where does this door go again!?"
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Omuzrdg.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Chainsaw Enhancements[/h1]
[list][*]Chainsaw now gives double the score multiplier.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4QPP35r.png[/img]
[*]Chainsaw now deals more damage.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hoLIWhS.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Enhanced Communication[/h1]
[list][*]Added "PRO TIPs" to level completion window, further reinforcing how to increase Roger's survivability.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/s3x4cEC.png[/img]
[*]Added numeric values for health.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VCQYAa7.png[/img]

notes.title: "Edu-ma-cational" Update for Demo
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for trying the demo of NO RELOADING.  We have enjoyed reading your comments, suggestions, and watching your videos!  Your feedback has been invaluable!

[h1]Edu-ma-cation[/h1]
This update specifically features a bit more tutorialization, reminding players to try their fancy new moves:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x0FEfes.png[/img]

In a similar vein, Roger now speaks about how style point "energize" (heal) him.  Very important to know that!

[h1]New Option: Invert Mouse[/h1]
Players may now invert the mouse in options.  Thanks Ndio for the suggestion!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2v82LpD.png[/img]

[h1]Objectives[/h1]
The objectives were proving to be tricky for players to fulfill, spot, so we have made a series of improvements and fixes:
[list]
[*]Substantially reduced the hit points of the servers for the "destroy server" objectives.
[*]Roger now speaks after destroying an objective, making it more clear it is accomplished.
[*]Increased the glow around objectives, to make them easier to see.
[*]Ensured the objective glow followed the objective if it moved.
[*]Standardized the names of the "destroy server" objectives.
[*]Duke's dog food is now required to pick up.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some projectiles were counting as melee.
[*] Player health could go above maximum, oops!
[*] The active "scorable stunts" indicator now clears at the end of each level, to avoid player confusion.
[*] "Excitement indicator" now hidden in demo.  That's for us, not you!
[/list]
